validation_notes: The chart shows a clear downtrend with lower highs and lower lows throughout, not a compressing triangle. Price fell from ~7.4 to ~6.4 over the period with successive swing highs (7.4, 7.2, 7.1, 7.0, 6.8) and swing lows (7.0, 6.85, 6.85, 6.55, 6.4) both declining, which is a downtrend/channel pattern rather than a descending triangle. A descending triangle requires a flat horizontal support line with repeated tests at the same level - here the lows keep making new lower lows (7.0 -> 6.85 -> 6.55 -> 6.4) without a flat base. Near the right edge, price is consolidating in a tight range around 6.4-6.6 but this looks like a flag/consolidation after a strong downtrend rather than a converging triangle with clear diagonal trendlines. No credible ascending or converging structure is visible at the right edge to suggest an imminent LONG breakout.
